mapper.select: SELECT 'U' AS ROLE , A.USER_ID , A.USER_NM , A.USER_PHONE , A.USER_ZIPCODE , A.USER_ADDR , A.USER_DETAIL_ADDR , A.CREATED_DT , A.CREATED_ID , A.UPDATED_DT , A.UPDATED_ID FROM TBL_USER A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT 'D' AS ROLE , A.DRIVER_ID , A.DRIVER_NM , A.DRIVER_PHONE , A.BUSINESS_NUMBER , A.TAXI_NUMBER , A.CREATED_DT , A.CREATED_ID , A.UPDATED_DT , A.UPDATED_ID FROM TBL_DRIVER A WHERE A.DRIVER_ID = #{driverId}
